params.name: lat
params.description:
Returns the pois near a point defined by lat (latitude) and lon (longitude) and optionally dist (distance) in metres (default: 1000).

Example: lat=47.349952

params.name: lon
params.description:
Returns the pois near a point defined by lat (latitude) and lon (longitude) and optionally dist (distance) in metres (default: 1000).

Example: lon=8.490838

params.name: dist
params.description:
Returns the pois near a point defined by lat (latitude) and lon (longitude) and optionally dist (distance) in metres (default: 1000).

Example: dist=1000

params.name: q
params.description:
Returns the data for the search term (q).The parameter "q" is alternative to "lat"/"lon".

Example: q=kyburg

params.name: edges
params.description:
Should the edges/relations to content items, dossiers and routes also be returned (default: true)?

Example: edges=false

items.docs: Returns pois and related resources from e-rara defined in the ETHorama database. References of POIs to E-Pics and other data are not yet available here.
